integrity: The proof explicitly identifies the stochastic recursion, the moment operator, the sharp stable region, the singular boundary, and an analytic gain supremum. Exact finite arithmetic checks supplement but do not replace infinite-domain arguments. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric positive-definite quadratic potentials, unbiased uniform-coordinate full-noise overdamped Langevin, and finite-second-moment stability are covered. The anisotropic-diagonal sharp frontier is derived only in dimension two. No total-variation, mixing-time, or Gaussianity claim is made for the stationary numerical law.
title: Sharp Gaussian covariance and correlated-curvature stability of random-coordinate Langevin sampling
